item.title: One person taken to hospital after Yarmouth crash
item.description: YARMOUTH – One person was transported to Cape Cod Hospital after a traffic crash in the Captains Village neighborhood of Yarmouth. The crash happened about 8:10 AM at Captain Wright Road and Captain Simmons Road. A Jeep Wrangler Unlimited and a Fiat 500 coupe collided. The injuries did not appear life-threatening.
